bom_invalid_or_unreliable.reason: Removed an invalid or misleading Byte Order Mark (BOM) from the file to ensure correct decoding

normalized_utf8.reason: Re-encoded the content as UTF-8 to normalize character encoding

fixed_data.reason: Corrected unreadable or misencoded characters in FIXED_LINES lines without data loss

partial_data_loss.reason: Corrected unreadable or misencoded characters in FIXED_LINES lines, but UNRECOVERABLE_LINES lines could not be fully recovered and remain partially corrupted

irreversible_data_loss.reason: Detected unreadable or misencoded characters in UNRECOVERABLE_LINES lines that could not be reliably recovered

no_valid_data.reason: Removed empty or unusable content from the file, leaving no valid data

bom_added_to_match_encoding.reason: Added a Byte Order Mark (BOM) to the file to match the detected encoding and ensure correct decoding

raw_strip.reason: Removed leading and/or trailing empty bytes from the raw content to normalize file structure before decoding

reconstructed_lines.reason: Reconstructed RECONSTRUCTED_LINES broken lines caused by embedded newlines inside quoted fields in structured or tabular content
